_about: Named sets of versions for Bible pages. The default edition's pages are romans-12.md; another edition's are romans-12.<name>.md. The app lists a passage once and switches between its editions on the page. Order here is the order of the app's menu. zh: cuv (simplified), cuv-trad (traditional), or both (the first is the main line). en, greek, hebrew: one or more, comma-separated, or none.
